title: Grateful Dead Live at Chateau d'Herouville on 1971-06-21
lineage: CD -> Samplitude Professional v10.1 -> Adobe Audition v1.5 -> FLAC
source: SBD -> Master Reel -> Dat -> CD D

ai_review.summary: Excellent soundboard capture of a high‑energy 1971 backyard gig with smoking Hard To Handle, The Other One and Wharf Rat.
ai_review.review: The Miller transfer delivers an intimate, crystal‑clear soundboard recording that lets every instrument breathe – the electric piano adds a fresh flavor, Bill Kreutzmann’s drumming shines, and Jerry Garcia’s guitar and vocals are front‑and‑center. Musically the show is a classic ’71 performance: Hard To Handle smokes, The Other One and Wharf Rat are monster versions, and Morning Dew is a revelation, with only a brief miscommunication on Casey Jones. Overall the energy is high and the vibe feels like an unforgettable house‑party at a French chateau.

ai_rating.rationale: Consistently strong 4–5 star reviews praising both performance and sound quality; weighted average of show (70%) and recording (30%) yields a high rating.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Crisp, intimate and clear mix with full instrument separation; every nuance of Jerry's guitar and vocals is audible. No major drop‑outs or muddiness reported.

show_quality.setlist_flow: Typical ’71 set delivered in a relaxed backyard setting; the flow feels natural with strong transitions and highlights spaced throughout.

band_member_comments.Jerry: Insanely good playing, crystal‑clear guitar tone, vocal performance spot on, subtleties evident in mix.
band_member_comments.Keys: Pig’s electric piano adds interesting texture; no organ present, giving a unique keyboard sound for 1971.
band_member_comments.Drums: Bill Kreutzmann praised as the real star of the night; powerful and dynamic drumming throughout.
